title: Hardware Inventory and Asset Records
summary: Use synthetic asset records to connect equipment identity with operational purpose.
objectives: Interpret asset ID, serial, hostname, rack position, status, and lifecycle fields.
Identify incomplete or contradictory inventory information.

vocab.def: A stable identifier assigned to an item for tracking.
A readable name used to identify a system on a network or record.

sections.heading: Identity supports care
sections.body: A record is useful when it connects an asset to its location, purpose, current status, and responsible workflow.

sections.heading: Synthetic records
sections.body: Classroom inventory examples are fictional. Never copy production serial numbers, hostnames, or employee information into practice work.

practice.prompt: Which field would help locate a simulated server?

quiz.question: What should you do when a hostname and rack position conflict?
options: Flag the discrepancy and ask an authorized person to verify it
quiz.answer: Flag the discrepancy and ask an authorized person to verify it

lab.objective: Review a synthetic inventory table and write one factual discrepancy note.

reflectionPrompt: How can accurate asset identity make troubleshooting safer?
